sources.modifications: Motion-only extraction: meshes, materials, images and textures removed; rig transforms, inverse-bind metadata and all original source keyframes retained. Runtime calibration uses the actual first animated anatomical pose, per-palm and finger-axis frames, proportional arm IK and source near-contact landmark-pair constraints on separately licensed Aarav. Detected terminal actor-axis reset keys and outlying joint-4 nodes are excluded from playback sampling; original raw tracks remain intact.
